description:
Remember where you've been with a private location timeline. Whereday records your visits and routes so you can revisit a day, explore places on a map, and keep a personal record of your travels.

YOUR DAYS, ON A MAP
• Automatically detect visits with place names and addresses
• Record GPS routes and review outings with route replay
• Browse visits and movements by date in your timeline
• Add past visits, correct arrival and departure times, and save familiar places
• Explore photos on your map

KEEP YOUR HISTORY USEFUL
• Track days spent in each country and add manual stays
• Export your history in JSON, CSV, Markdown, GPX, or KML
• Schedule exports and organize your files by day
• Use Shortcuts to work with visits, movements, and exports
• Record routes on Apple Watch and sync them to your iPhone
• Follow active tracking from your Lock Screen with Live Activities

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your location history is stored on your device. No account is required for location tracking.

Tracking is free and unlimited. Unlock data export with a one-time Individual Lifetime or Family Lifetime purchase.
promotionalText: Remember the places you've been. Explore your location timeline, see photos on the map, and track days in each country. Free tracking, with lifetime export options.
whatsNew:
Your visit and outing notes can now come along when you add a timeline event to Calendar.

Notes are filled in automatically, preserving line breaks. Review, edit, or remove them in the calendar editor before saving.

If you just edited or cleared notes on the detail screen, your next calendar draft uses that latest text. Blank notes stay empty, so old text does not reappear in a new draft.

Notes are copied once when you create an event. Later edits in Whereday do not change events already saved in your calendar.
